name: Heavenly Kashmir Odyssey
route: Srinagar Arrival → Srinagar → Doodhpatri → Srinagar → Yusmarg → Srinagar → Sonmarg → Srinagar → Gulmarg → Pahalgam
description: Discover the pristine beauty of Kashmir with InfinitiV Adventure Srinagar Doodhpatri Tour Package an expedition through tranquil valleys, sparkling lakes, and verdant meadows. This carefully curated itinerary has a winning balance of nature, history and local flavour for a restorative holiday in paradise. Start your journey with the Avantipur Ruins and the curative Anantnag Sulphur Springs before moving on to Chandanwadi, Thajiwas Glacier, Aru Valley, and Betaab Valley—each more picturesque than the last. In an equally mesmerizing environment, Gulmarg, you can bask in the world’s highest golf course and the multi-hued Meadow of Flowers, while Srinagar keeps finding ways to stun you with the Mughal Gardens, like Nishat Garden, Chashme Shahi, gardens, etc. Glide past the Floating and Vegetable Gardens on Dal Lake and Golden Lake, stopping to shop for local treasures at Mena Bazar. Visit spiritual sites such as Shankaracharya Temple, Pari Mahal and Ali Mardan Khan Garden engulfed by the beautiful Zabarwan Mountains. Then fall into the dreamlike green expanse of Doodhpatri, celebrated for its swishy green grass, and conclude with the peaceful Yusmarg and the serene Nilnag Lake.
highlights: Srinagar → Doodhpathri → Yusmarg → Sonamarg → Gulmarg → Pahalgam → Srinagar
Weather can change quickly—pack warm clothing year-round
Local transport unions may apply for certain destinations
Activities like pony rides and gondola rides are optional
Follow local guidelines and respect natural surroundings

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival
itinerary.desc: Welcome to Srinagar Airport. You will be meet our representative and get transferred to Hotel. Check-in Hotel. After relax visit Shankaracharya Temple in the evening enjoy beautiful evening at Srinagar. Overnight stay in the Hotel

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Doodhpatri - Srinagar
itinerary.desc: After breakfast proceed to visit Doodhpatri. The Valley of Kashmir still holds many beautiful secrets. One of these is the Valley of Doodhpathri in Srinagar. We went there this May. The snow caps on the surrounding mountains had still not melted. The floor of the valley was still covered with snow. The snow on the slopes surrounding the valley had however melted and were now covered with lush green grass. The magical color play of brown mud, shiny green grass and pure white snow looked enchanting! Overnight stay at Srinagar Hotel

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Yusmarg - Srinagar
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast, proceed for an excursion tour to Yusmarg. Yusmarg is a small meadow set in the heart of mountains to the south-west of Srinagar. It is an ideal picnic spot and the Nilnag Lake can be visited from here. A two hour drive from Srinagar (47 kms ) will take you to acres upon acres of grassy meadow ringed by forests of pine, and towering beyond them, awesome and majestic snow clad mountains. Laterreturn to Srinagar. overnight stay in Srinagar Hotel

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Sonmarg
itinerary.desc: After breakfast leave for Sonamarg for a Day trip the name Sonamarg is derived from two Kashmiri words “Son” & “Marg” which mean “Gold” & “Meadow”, when put together it means “Meadow of Gold” The drive from Srinagar to Sonamarg is very beautiful as you will pass through some towns and villages, at many places you can enjoy the view of paddy fields with rivers flowing on one side. in Sonamarg you can visit Thajwas Glacier ( Own Cost) which is around 4Kms from Sonamarg a Local Taxi Or Pony Ride has to be hired) return back to Hotel in the evening after enjoying your day, overnight stay in Hotel at Sonmarg

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Gulmarg
itinerary.desc: Srinagar to Gulmarg “Meadow of Flowers” Discovered by the Kashmiri romantic poet in the 16th century who was inspired by its grassy slopes covered with wildflowers. In winter Gulmarg looks more beautiful due to heavy snowfall. It turns into India & premier Ski resort in winter. After check in, leave with your guide for some adventure activity in Gulmarg. Overnight stay at Gulmarg

itinerary.title: Gulmarg - Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: Today you will be transferred by road to Pahalgam. Valley of Shepherds. En route, you will have a rare opportunity to visit the Saffron fields. Also, visit Avantipur Ruins & Anantnag Sulphur Springs en route, Arrive and proceed to your hotel, overnight at the Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Inn Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast, Visit Aru Valley, Betab Valley & Chandanwadi (Own Cost), The snow Point (14 Km) at your own cost or enjoy a pony ride at your own cost, Return back to Pahalgam, the rest of the day at leisure to explore the countryside and enjoy leisurely walks through the pine forest along the River Lidder. overnight stay at the hotel

itinerary.title: Pahalgam - Srinagar - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: After breakfast transfer to Srinagar. visit Pari Mahal & Palace of Fairies& (is a seven terraced garden located at the top of Zabarwan mountain range over-looking city of Srinagar and south-west of Dal Lake) Then visit Chashme Shahi (is one of the Mughal gardens built in 1632 AD around a spring by Ali Mardan Khan, a governor of Mughal emperor Shah Jahan as per the orders of the Emperor, as a gift for his elder son Prince Dara Shikoh) you will also visit Nishat Garden known as & Garden of pleasure & built-in 16th century (1633) by Mughal King Asif Khan. Then visit Shalimar Garden known as & Garden of love & built-in the 16th century (1619) by Mughal King Jehangir for his beloved wife Noor Jehan or (Mehr-un Nissa) evening enjoy Shikara ride on the world-famous Dal Lake in which you will cover, Floating Gardens, Vegetable Gardens, Golden Lake, Inner markets like Mena Bazar, and Canals, etc, also enjoy the scenic view of Zabarwan Mountains, evening free for leisure, overnight stay in Houseboat at Srinagar

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast get a transfer to Srinagar Airport for further next destination back Home
